text.offer: Good, you're armed. Now, Rodric d'Stane, our elder, has been asking for anyone with a strong arm. Something is wrong in the mausoleum, and the town is frightened. You'll find him in his hut in the southeast corner of town. Go and hear him out.
text.progress: Rodric d'Stane lives in a hut in the southeast corner of Raza. Look for the gold "?" over his head.
text.complete: Rodric d'Stane says, "Marcus sent you? Good. Raza has need of you, newcomer. Sit, and I'll tell you what has befallen our dead."

steps.objective: Speak to Rodric d'Stane, the elder
